summary: MEZAN rebrand (Iter-84) verified end-to-end on /login, /register, post-login sidebar, mobile header, cross-page navigation, document <title>, meta tags (theme-color, apple, og:title), favicon.svg endpoint, and primary button color. All required testids resolve to the expected MEZAN/ميزان brand block and the new green #0F5D46 is applied. No remnants of the old 'حساب' brand element found in brand surfaces.

issues: Text content reads as 'MEZANميزان · تحليلات' with no whitespace between English and Arabic when scraped (visually OK because they are on separate <div> lines, but a screen reader would concatenate). Cosmetic only — not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: MezanLogo.jsx: LogoFull renders an extra inner data-testid='mezan-logo-icon' for the SVG — fine, but be aware multiple icons exist per page (LogoIcon used standalone in Login/Register/Sidebar/Layout already provides the testid). Tests should use .first if querying app-wide.

Sidebar.jsx still references storage key 'hesab.sidebar.openSection' — harmless but a leftover of the previous brand; consider renaming to 'mezan.sidebar.openSection' (with backward migration) on a future pass.

Login page hero copy still reads 'منصة سلة • تحليل ذكي' which is fine (Salla is an integration partner, not the product name), but verify with product if 'MEZAN • منصة سلة • تحليل ذكي' is the intended marketing phrasing.
/settings route logged 403 in console for one merchant endpoint during the rebrand smoke (unrelated to rebrand; pre-existing permissions guard). Not actioned here per scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-84 rebrand fully verified. Validated artifacts: data-testid mezan-logo-icon, login-brand-en (MEZAN), login-brand-ar (ميزان), tagline, register brand block, sidebar-brand/sidebar-brand-en (MEZAN)/sidebar-brand-ar (ميزان · تحليلات التجارة), mobile-header-brand (mobile @ 390x844). Document <title> = 'MEZAN — ميزان · منصة التحليلات والمحاسبة للتجارة الإلكترونية'. theme-color=#0F5D46, apple-mobile-web-app-title=MEZAN, og:title='MEZAN — ميزان'. /favicon.svg returned 200 with <svg> body. Login submit button computed bg = rgb(15,93,70) = #0F5D46. Cross-page sidebar persistence confirmed on /, /accounts, /reports, /reconciliation, /settings.
